title: Example 20-27: Pronunciation Key in Columns with Headings

illustrates.quote: c. When pronunciation keys are shown in columns, list the entries using 1-3 margins, or 1-5, 3-5 for a nested list. Omit print column headings. Explain the change to print in a transcriber’s note.

blocks.text:
Symbol	Example Words
a	at, bad
e	even
ng	long, pink
oi	oil, toy
u	up, mud
zh	vision, seizure
blocks.features: Two columns with underlined headings 'Symbol' and 'Example Words'; bold letters mark the sounds in the example words (at, the a of bad, ng of long, n of pink, oil, up, u of mud, i of vision, z of seizure, as far as the image resolves)

print.notes: Print original is the picture in the example box; transcribed from the page image (gold-20-A/page-548.png).

braille.notes: Margin stripped: 10. 4 blank source lines between the caption and the first braille line are the print-original picture area, not braille, and are excluded.

uncertain: Which letters are bold in the example words was read from a low-resolution image; the braille emphasis marks (^2..1, ^1..1 etc.) were not used to decide.
